> **Platform**: Android

# ZodiakTitle ✅ Ported

```kotlin
@Composable
fun ZodiakTitle(
    text: String,
    modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
    color: Color = Color.Unspecified,
)
```

Style: `MaterialTheme.typography.titleMedium` (16sp Medium)
iOS equivalent: `ZodiakText(style: .title2)`

**When to use:** Section titles, card headers, subsection separators.
